name: Smiling Cat
look: A close-up photo of a tabby-and-white cat leaning toward the camera with huge, round, dark eyes and a pink nose. The corners of its mouth turn up so it seems to be smiling sweetly. A cluttered room with a red curtain is blurred behind it.
use: A wholesome or quietly smug reaction for when something pleasant happens or you feel pleased with yourself. The caption names the happy moment, like a compliment, payday or plans getting canceled.
slots: the happy moment (caption above or below)
examples: When the plans I didn't want to go to get canceled
Me when someone says my cooking tastes like a restaurant's
